name: case10
title: sma_cross with a resting limit, long only, Binance spot BTCUSDT, 1h, March 2023 with the exchange's outage of 24 March
about: Two missing hours (one bucket dropped as incomplete, one with no minutes), a sell limit resting across them and filled on the first bar after, cancels after N bars, equity sizing
exercise_note: No period was searched for the missing ones: the search for a perpetual period with a dropped bucket that carries a real price move, ideally with a funding stamp inside it, was stopped before it found one, and nothing from it is used. On this case as it stands, funding in a gap cannot happen (a spot instrument has no funding), and its one dropped bucket moves the price by 0.01, so no resting limit can open through it.
